name: tractor_12f4r
source: I3 stand-in for a 3-range x 4-gear synchro-shuttle tractor gearbox (12F/12R class, e.g. the SyncShuttle-type boxes of 75-100 kW tractors - brochure class, not a specific product), flattened to one sequential list ordered by speed so shift_up/shift_down walk it: forward ratios are a geometric progression from 21.0 to 1.07 (step 1.31), giving 2.0-39.7 km/h at 2200 rpm with the 20.0 rear final drive and 1.025 m rear tyres; 4 reverse ratios (1.8-9.3 km/h). All positions synchronised (a real range change is usually unsynchronised: the range/shuttle selector structure, park lock and governor land in I4 - PHYS-033 section 9 'Tractor specifics'). Efficiency 0.95 per position (multi-stage spur train; Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, ch. 3 overall tractor transmission efficiencies ~0.85-0.92 - verify). PHYS-033 I3.
